Welcome to the Girl art museum.
We are pleased to announce that we will be holding a new “Special Exhibition” at our museum.

In this Special Exhibition, we will present works previously on display in a new light. In particular, the collaborative arrangements featuring multiple works can only be seen here. However, this exhibition is for a limited time only. Once the exhibition ends, the works will return to the permanent collection in their original forms.

To kick things off, we’re launching the first installment: a special exhibition featuring No. 03 and No. 06, titled “Anal Comparison.”

[2_01.jpg]

“Anal Comparison.” This work consists of two figures who, despite being like cats and dogs, share the same fate. The two are always glaring at each other, but in this special exhibition, they are peacefully coexisting within a single frame.

Now, the highlight of this work is, without a doubt, the two greatly dilated anuses. However, when you compare the two anuses, you’ll notice that their shapes are quite different.

[2_02.jpg]

No. 03’s anus is wide open in a perfectly round shape. This is likely because she has supported her entire body weight with her anus for many years. Her anus has been stretched beyond its limits to conform to the shape of a dildo.

Her anal sphincter is completely stretched out, and she is unable to close her anus. However, its sensitivity has become extremely high. This is because she was forced to endure years of having torture-grade aphrodisiacs rubbed into it to alleviate the pain.

Not only the anus, but the intestinal walls and the sigmoid colon have also been transformed into erogenous zones. The anus, which has endured torture-level pain, has been reborn as the ultimate erogenous zone, capable of experiencing pleasure from any kind of play.

[2_03.jpg]

In contrast, the anus of No. 06 has a shape where the surrounding area bulges outward. The opening extends vertically, and while it retains more constrictive force than No. 03, it still cannot close completely.

Although the degree of dilation appears smaller than that of No. 03, it stretches extremely well and can expand just as much as No. 03. Having had various foreign objects inserted and removed almost daily, it has likely transformed into a shape capable of flexibly accommodating any object.

In addition, the secretion of intestinal fluids has increased significantly, and this seems to act as a lubricant, helping her endure intense anal training. Of course, it’s not just about endurance. Her thoroughly developed anus has also become highly sensitive.

Now that we've compared the two anuses from the front, let's go around to the back.

[2_04.jpg]

Behind the wall, you can watch No. 03 and No. 06 entwined in a loving embrace. Don’t worry—they’re wearing mouth guards to keep them from biting each other.

In this special exhibition, we plan to compare the two figures’ anuses in various ways, including dilation, sensitivity, and enemas. Whether they’re writhing in agony, crying out, or moaning in pleasure… they’ll be forced to expose themselves like this right in front of the person they hate the most.

Additionally, the two figures’ necks are connected by a powerful spring. Right now, No. 06 is arching their back, but if they continue to be pulled strongly, they’ll eventually reach their limit. When that happens, you might even get to see the two of them kissing.

So, what did you think?
This is a special, limited-time exhibition—why not take this opportunity to visit our museum?
